title: SARS-CoV-2 CD8+ T cell killing assays using replicating viruses and transgenic antigens
protocol: Design DNA template as described in Moosmann et al., 2022.
Reconstitute tracrRNA, hTRAC crRNA and hTRBC crRNA to 80 μM.
Reconstitute the electroporation enhancer to 400 μM in nuclease-free duplex buffer.
Reconstitute IL-2 to 10 μg/mL.
Reconstitute IL-7 and IL-15 to 25 μg/mL.
Aliquot biotin to 100 μM stocks.
Aliquot and store all reagents at -20°C.
Run 2 μL per HDR PCR reaction on a 1% agarose gel to control for successful amplification.
Perform DNA purification using the MinElute PCR Purification Kit.
Store purified HDR template at 1 μg/μL at −20°C.
Dilute fresh blood 1:0.4 with PBS (e.g., mix 25 mL of blood with 10 mL PBS).
Add 15 mL of Ficoll in 50 mL tubes.
Carefully layer the blood:PBS dilution on top of Ficoll, tilting the tube at a 45-degree angle and adding the mixture dropwise.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 1,000 × g at 20°C–22°C with deceleration break turned off.
Take off the plasma up to ∼ 0.5 cm over the PBMC layer.
Isolate the PBMC layer in a 50 mL tube.
Fill up with PBS to 50 mL and centrifuge for 10 min at 480 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Wash isolated PBMCs two more times with 50 mL PBS.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed cells at a density of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in complete RPMI medium supplemented with 300 U/mL IL-2, 5 ng/mL IL-7, and 5 ng/mL IL-15.
Add CD3/CD28 expander (Poltorak et al., 2020) at a concentration of 1.5 μL per 10^6 cells.
Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for two days.
Take off PBMCs and centrifuge for 10 min at 480 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Resuspend PBMCs in 1 mM biotin for 20 min at 20°C–22°C (use 50 mL cell culture volume with 25 mL of 1 mM biotin solution).
Fill up the tube to 50 mL with PBS and centrifuge for 10 min at 480 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Perform one more wash step with 30 mL PBS and centrifuge for 10 min at 480 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Perform a final wash step with 50 mL complete RPMI medium.
Count PBMCs.
Split the total cell number according to different experimental conditions.
Divide appropriate volumes into 15 mL tubes.
Place cells in the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2) until electroporation.
Mix equal volumes of tracrRNA with hTRAC or hTRBC crRNA (80 μM) respectively to prepare 40 μM hTRAC or hTRBC gRNA.
Heat gRNA for 5 min at 95°C.
Allow gRNA to cool to 20°C–22°C.
Add 20 μM electroporation enhancer to gRNA.
Dilute Cas9 nuclease (stock: 61 μM) to 6 μM with commercial PBS.
Mix very slowly equal volumes of 6 μM Cas9 protein and 40 μM gRNA (= tracrRNA + crRNA).
Incubate RNP complexes for 15 min at 20°C–22°C.
Prepare P3 electroporation buffer according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Centrifuge cells for 10 min at 480 × g at 20°C–22°C and resuspend in 60 μL P3 buffer, assuming a cell pellet volume of 10 μL.
Mix together: 10 μL of TRAC RNP, 10 μL of TRBC RNP and 10 μL of HDR template (10 μg of a 1 μg/μL HDR stock solution).
Incubate assembled RNP solution for at least 30 s at 20°C–22°C.
Mix PBMCs resuspended in P3 buffer with the assembled RNP solution to reach a final volume of 100 μL.
Transfer cells to 100 μL Nucleocuvette™ Vessels for electroporation using program EH100.
Transfer electroporated cells to pre-warmed flasks containing RPMI-SC- medium (RPMI medium, 10% FCS, SC- supplement) to achieve a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Supplement RPMI-SC- medium with 5% antibiotic mix 12–16 hours after electroporation.
Incubate cells for 3 days at 37°C in an atmosphere containing 5% CO2.
Prepare antibody mix containing CD3-BV421 (1:100), CD8-PE (1:600), hTCR-FITC (1:50), and mTRBC-APC/Fire750 (1:50) in FACS buffer.
Incubate the antibody mix with cell aliquots for 20 minutes on ice in the dark.
Add PI (propidium iodide) to the antibody-stained cells at a ratio of 1:100 and incubate for an additional minute on ice in the dark.
Wash the stained cells twice with FACS buffer.
Filter the washed cells through 112 μm polyamid sieve cloth.
Acquire a minimum of 10,000 events using CytoFlex S Cell Analyzer.
Analyze data using FlowJo V10 software.
Perform antibody staining for the transgenic TCR on ∼day 5 post CRISPR editing.
Sort SARS-CoV-2-specific TCR engineered CD8+ T cells in 1 mL FCS in 15 mL tubes.
Centrifuge sorted cells at 480 × g for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged sample.
Resuspend cells in complete RPMI-HS medium + 1 μg/mL PHA + 180 IU/mL IL-2 to reach a final concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
If less than 200,000 cells are sorted, fill up with irradiated feeder cells (35 Gy–20 min) from an allogeneic donor.
Add feeder cells to achieve a total of at least 200,000 cells for expansion.
Expect between 5 × 10^6 and 30 × 10^6 cells after three weeks of culture.
Remove 100 μL of medium on day 7.
Add fresh complete HS-RPMI medium + 1 μg/mL PHA + 180 IU IL-2/mL (final concentration).
Check the medium every 1–3 days; add fresh medium supplemented with cytokines when it turns yellow.
If adding new medium less than 2 days apart, only add cytokines for the added medium to avoid overstimulation.
Add 1 mL of complete RPMI medium + 3× IL-2 to 2 mL of culture medium and cells in a 6-well plate.
Do not add PHA from this point onward.
Leave cells for approximately 7 days without PHA addition, adding IL-2 every 2–3 days before performing experiments.
Double the volume of medium when it turns yellow or proliferation clusters are visible.
Transfer cells to a larger plate only when necessary based on cell coverage and metabolic activity.
If cells do not show metabolic activity by day seven, add another 100,000 irradiated feeder cells from the same donor.
Seed 5 × 10^3 competent A549 cells in complete RPMI medium in 100 μL per well of a 96-well plate.
Place PBS in the outermost wells to prevent evaporation.
Add SARS-CoV-2-GFP virus (MOI 5) in 100 μL of complete RPMI medium 24 hours after seeding.
Place the infected plates in the Incucyte S3 instrument at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Capture real-time images of mock cells (RFP channel) and infected cells (GFP and RFP channel) every 3 hours for 72 hours.
Resuspend TCR-engineered T cells at a concentration of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL in complete RPMI medium + 100 IU/mL IL-2.
Dilute the respective higher dilution in complete RPMI medium + 100 IU/mL IL-2 to prepare E:T dilution series.
Perform all E:T titration steps in triplicates.
Remove 100 μL of medium from the plate with a multichannel pipette, 24 hours post-infection.
Add 100 μL of respective E:T SARS-CoV-2-specific T cells to the plate.
Place the plate back in the Incucyte S3 instrument and continue acquisition for an additional 48 hours.
Remove supernatant and T cells by washing wells once with PBS at the endpoint (72 hours post-infection).
Add fresh medium before final picture acquisition.
Seed competent A549-Nsp2 cells on an E-Plate VIEW 96-WP.
Monitor impedance measurement and image acquisition with the xCELLigence eSight instrument.
Incubate seeded cells for 24 hours post-seeding.
Add SARS-CoV-2-specific, TCR-engineered CD8+ T cells to the incubated A549-Nsp2 cells.
Continue monitoring acquisition for an additional 48 hours.
Resuspend SARS-CoV-2-specific, TCR-engineered CD8+ T cells at a concentration of 3 × 10^6/mL in complete RPMI medium + 100 IU/mL IL-2.
Prepare and pipette E:T dilution series by always diluting the respective higher dilution in complete RPMI medium + 100 IU/mL IL-2.
Perform all E:T titration steps in triplicates.
Pipet E:T dilution series of SARS-CoV-2-specific T cells.
Pause the experiment and take the E-Plate VIEW out of the xCELLigence eSight instrument after 24 hours post-seeding.
Remove 100 μL of medium with a multichannel pipette.
Add 100 μL of SARS-CoV-2-specific, TCR-engineered CD8+ T cells according to the respective E:T ratio.
Include medium only condition as negative control and 2% Triton X as positive control for each cell line.
Place the E-Plate VIEW back in the xCELLigence eSight instrument.
Start/Continue acquisition for additional 48 hours.
Peptide-pulse competent A549 cells at a concentration of 3 × 10^6/mL for 2 h with 10^-5 M peptide at 20°C–22°C on a roller.
Wash peptide-pulsed cells three times with full RPMI medium.
Seed respective amounts of target cells, including controls (unpulsed competent A549 cells), on the E-Plate VIEW.
